mapper.sql: FROM tb_stocktake t JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = t.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.user_id = t.closed_by

t.take_seq, t.take_no, t.take_name, t.warehouse_seq, t.take_type, t.take_status, t.blind_yn, t.target_zone, t.target_sku_keyword, t.planned_date, t.started_at, t.closed_by, t.closed_at, t.remark, t.created_by, t.created_at, t.updated_by, t.updated_at, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, p.plant_id AS plant_id, p.plant_name AS plant_name, p.org_seq AS org_seq, cu.user_name AS closed_by_name, c.line_count, c.counted_count, c.diff_count

LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.qty_counted IS NOT NULL) AS counted_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.qty_diff IS NOT NULL AND l.qty_diff <> 0) AS diff_count FROM tb_stocktake_line l WHERE l.take_seq = t.take_seq ) c ON TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_stocktake (take_no, take_name, warehouse_seq, take_type, take_status, blind_yn, target_zone, target_sku_keyword, planned_date, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{takeNo}, #{takeName}, #{warehouseSeq}, #{takeType}, #{takeStatus}, #{blindYn}, #{targetZone}, #{targetSkuKeyword}, #{plannedDate}, #{remark}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_stocktake SET take_name = #{takeName}, warehouse_seq = #{warehouseSeq}, take_type = #{takeType}, blind_yn = #{blindYn}, target_zone = #{targetZone}, target_sku_keyword = #{targetSkuKeyword}, planned_date = #{plannedDate}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE take_seq = #{takeSeq}

UPDATE tb_stocktake SET take_status = #{toStatus},
started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
closed_by = #{closedBy}, closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
updated_by = COALESCE(#{closedBy}, updated_by), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE take_seq = #{takeSeq} AND take_status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_stocktake_line (take_seq, location_seq, sku_seq, supplier_seq, stock_seq, qty_book) VALUES (#{takeSeq}, #{locationSeq}, #{skuSeq}, #{supplierSeq}, #{stockSeq}, #{qtyBook})
mapper.select:
SELECT tl.line_seq, tl.take_seq, tl.location_seq, tl.sku_seq, tl.supplier_seq, tl.stock_seq, tl.qty_book, tl.qty_counted, tl.counted_by, tl.counted_at, tl.qty_recount, tl.recount_by, tl.recount_at, tl.qty_final, tl.qty_diff, tl.line_status, tl.reason_code, tl.remark, tl.applied_history_seq, l.location_id AS location_id, l.zone_code AS zone_code, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, p.plant_id AS plant_id, k.sku_id AS sku_id, pr.product_name AS product_name, k.color_code AS color_code, k.size_code AS size_code, rc.code_name AS reason_name, s.qty_on_hand AS qty_current FROM tb_stocktake_line tl JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_seq = tl.location_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = l.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = tl.sku_seq JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq LEFT JOIN tb_stock s ON s.stock_seq = tl.stock_seq LEFT JOIN tb_code_group rg ON rg.code_group_id = 'REASON_ADJUST' LEFT JOIN tb_code rc ON rc.code_group_seq = rg.code_group_seq AND rc.code_id = tl.reason_code WHERE tl.take_seq = #{takeSeq}
AND tl.qty_diff IS NOT NULL AND tl.qty_diff <> 0
AND tl.qty_counted IS NULL
ORDER BY l.location_id, k.sku_id

SELECT tl.line_seq, tl.take_seq, tl.location_seq, tl.sku_seq, tl.supplier_seq, tl.stock_seq, tl.qty_book, tl.qty_counted, tl.counted_by, tl.counted_at, tl.qty_recount, tl.recount_by, tl.recount_at, tl.qty_final, tl.qty_diff, tl.line_status, tl.reason_code, tl.remark, tl.applied_history_seq, l.location_id AS location_id, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, p.plant_id AS plant_id, k.sku_id AS sku_id FROM tb_stocktake_line tl JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_seq = tl.location_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = l.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = tl.sku_seq WHERE tl.line_seq = #{lineSeq}
mapper.update:
UPDATE tb_stocktake_line SET
qty_recount = #{qty}, recount_by = #{actor}, recount_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
qty_counted = #{qty}, counted_by = #{actor}, counted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
reason_code = #{reasonCode},
remark = #{remark},
line_status = #{lineStatus} WHERE line_seq = #{lineSeq}
UPDATE tb_stocktake_line SET line_status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE take_seq = #{takeSeq} AND qty_counted IS NOT NULL
